name: 4th Dan

practical.title: Se-Jong
practical.detail: 24 movements. Named after King Se-Jong, who created the Korean alphabet in 1443. Starts from closed ready stance B.

practical.title: Tong-IL
practical.detail: 56 movements. Symbolises the reunification of Korea, divided since 1945. Starts from parallel stance with overlapped back hand.

practical.title: Ul-Ji
practical.detail: 42 movements. Named after General Ul-Ji Moon Dok, who defended Korea against a Tang invasion in 612 AD. Starts from parallel stance with X-back hand.
